usd_reason: The Fed is likely to continue raising interest rates to address inflation, which will strengthen the US dollar
gold_reason: Higher interest rates will increase the opportunity cost of holding gold, leading to a decrease in its value

lead_story: The upcoming inflation report is the biggest macro driver right now, with the Fed expected to raise interest rates if inflation is high. This will have a significant impact on the US dollar and the overall economy. The report will be closely watched by investors and policymakers alike.
